name: How long does a garage conversion project typically take to complete?
description: Most garage conversions take 4 to 12 weeks of active construction, with timelines varying based on whether plumbing and full bathrooms are included.

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage conversion project typically take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most garage conversions take between four to twelve weeks of construction once permits are issued, depending on project complexity. The timeline begins with structural preparations, including framing out the main garage door opening, leveling the floor, and running rough electrical, plumbing, and mechanical lines. Once rough-in inspections pass, crews install insulation, hang and finish drywall, lay flooring, and install trim and interior doors. A dry living space or bedroom moves much faster than an apartment conversion that includes a walk-in shower, vanity, and complex plumbing lines trenched through the concrete.
